displayName: Woocommerce Coupon Discount for Specific Products

pitfalls.summary: Coupons with this plugin's 'apply only to specific products' setting are imported switched off, with a cutover task to switch each on, change it, or leave it off, until the plugin's exact behaviour is verified. Authoring note: verify first — read the plugin's main PHP file; if the flag only repeats WooCommerce core's product-limited discount (which a Wix product-scoped coupon already does), change the couponRules meaning to no-effect.

quirks: Seen on a real store (2026-10-28): set to 'yes' on 21 of 4,311 coupons, mostly fixed_cart/fixed_product coupons that already list product_ids. Version 1.0; source not reachable in the authoring pass (wordpress.org connection reset).
